lines.text: It's in a chat. No, an email. The ticket's in Jira, the comments are in WhatsApp, and the file wants a login.
And the new guy? Still waiting for his invite.
So try this. Everyone opens Orbi Transfer /work. No app, no account, no invite.
Drop the deck in, and it lands on every screen in the office, in about a second.
Same office Wi-Fi? Then it's under Nearby, so your team's stuff is right there.
Need a quick word? Post a note. Everyone gets their own colour, and it's gone in 30 minutes. No group chat to scroll.
Now the work. Type a task, add @Leo, and it's his.
It moves step by step. Doing, Review, Done. And everyone sees the bar fill up.
Under the hood, every open screen keeps one live line to the room. A change rings through to everyone at once. Nothing to refresh.
Want it just for your team? Go private, and only your people get in.
And when the last task is done?
Orbi Work. Files, notes and tasks, instantly. orbitransfer.com/work.
